summary: External-runtime adapter for Codex (first), with a durable out-of-band record stream and a stable renderer projection.

renderer.note: The UI agent owns the slot and renders the projection; OAR does not ship a parallel web renderer.

config.description: External runtime adapter. fake is simulated=true and is never used as a live model.
Codex sandbox mode; OAR defaults to read-only.
Reject a simulated runtime with simulated_runtime.
Codex executable; empty means PATH lookup.

limits: Record schema is frozen at keel.oar.record/1; one record is <= 1 MiB.
seq is strictly increasing per backend session; gaps are allowed after a crash.
No task-card instruction is injected into prompts; attribution is out of band.
streaming token deltas, approval bridging, Claude, and cross-sidecar resume are not in v1.
